methods.label: Nonzero multiples of a normal
methods.explanation: A nonzero multiple of a normal vector is still perpendicular to the plane. A direction vector in the plane is parallel to the plane and is not a normal vector.
methods.levelReason: The method uses the normal-vector definition and elementary direction properties of scalar multiplication.
